description: **Agent definitions are now schema-validated at load.** `.agent.json` documents loaded via `load_agent`/`discover_agents`/the `agent` CLI are validated against a strictspec schema before decoding: they now REQUIRE an integer `format_version` (currently `1`), and unknown keys (with did-you-mean hints) or wrong-typed fields are rejected with hard `AgentValidationError`s. Stamp existing agent files with `"format_version": 1` one time.
